projects.name: payments-service
projects.description: Fernhill's payout and billing service. Demo data.
facts: payments-service: every payout call carries an idempotency key built from the payout id, so a retried call can never pay twice.
payments-service: retries on the bank API stop after 3 attempts with jittered backoff starting at 2 seconds; after that the payout is parked for a human.
payments-service: changes to the retry logic need a second reviewer from the payments on-call rota.

projects.name: web-app
facts: web-app: the dashboard never retries a payout itself; it polls the payout status endpoint every 5 seconds and shows a pending badge.
web-app: network errors in the dashboard are retried by the fetch wrapper in src/lib/http.ts, never in components.
web-app: feature flags live in flags.yaml and ship dark first.

projects.name: platform-runbooks
projects.description: On-call runbooks shared by the platform team. Demo data.
facts: platform-runbooks: a payout stuck in parked state for more than an hour pages the payments on-call.
platform-runbooks: before changing retry behaviour anywhere, check the incident log for the bank API's current rate limit.

projects.name: ledger-migration
projects.description: The ledger migration, finished this sprint. Demo data.
facts: ledger-migration: during the migration, payout retries were disabled behind the flag ledger_dual_write.
ledger-migration: the old ledger tables are read-only and will be dropped after the migration closes.
Priya prefers retry changes to land behind a feature flag with a dashboard first.
Priya reviews in the morning and wants small, single-purpose pull requests.

facts: review-bot lesson: flag any retry loop without an upper bound on attempts.
review-bot lesson: a retry that re-sends a payout without the idempotency key is a blocking comment.
